design.status: The school's proposal, drafted by Claude on 28 Sep 2026 for discussion. Not official and not agreed. Official numbers come from NCF-SE, checked by research/timetable_data.py.

scenarios.label: Monday to Friday, with NCF-SE's 20 test days
Saturdays, and 8 test days instead of 20

concept.label: Concept
concept.what: A new idea, introduced creatively: a hook, a story or a game; objects before pictures before symbols.

practice.label: Level practice
practice.what: Practice at each child's own level. Children regroup across sections, and across grades where the bells line up.

check.label: Customised check
check.what: A short personal check set by the worksheet engine. Its result decides tomorrow's group.

application.label: Studio
application.what: Projects, investigations, labs and making that draw on several subjects at once.

arts.label: Arts
arts.what: Visual art, music, dance and theatre.

community.label: Circle & close
community.what: Morning circle or advisory, then the day's reflection and a portfolio note.

design.anatomy_note: How an academic hour is spent. The school's Grade 2–4 ICT plan already runs 10 minutes of shared hook, 35 minutes of practice by grade and 15 minutes of evaluation.

illustrative.quote: The specific time allocations described in this section must be seen as illustrative, and the actual time allocations must be conducted by schools, in accordance with their contexts

hours_are_schools_call.quote: The actual decision on the exact number of working hours would be taken by schools or school systems, and the proportion and rhythm of the illustrative timetable in the NCF could still be held

foundational_minutes.quote: R1 would need 90 minutes every day and R2 would need 60 minutes. Mathematics and numeracy would require 60 minutes a day

working_days.quote: The annual working year, for schools, has 220 instruction or school-going days after taking into consideration national holidays, term breaks and vacations

assessment_days.quote: Of these 220 days, around 20 days may be considered for assessments and other assessment-related activities across stages

event_days.quote: Another 20 days may be set aside for school events and other similar activities

instruction_days.quote: a safe estimate can be of 180 days of instruction time across these three stages at school

saturdays.quote: the model here has considered five and a half days of school every alternate week only

prep_hours.quote: R1+Library 180 270 R2 190 285 Mathematics (Maths) 185 277.5 The World Around Us (TWAU) 200 300 Art Education (Art) 100 150 Physical Education (PE) 100 150

middle_hours.quote: R1+Library 65 97.5 R2 70 105 R3 75 112.5 Mathematics (Maths) 115 172.5 Science 160 240 Social Science (SS) 160 240 Art Education (Art) 100 150 Physical Education (PE) 100 150 Vocational Education (VE) 110 165

art_pe_ve_need_time.quote: In this NCF, they need explicit and significant time allocation

periods_projects.quote: Periods build capability. Projects integrate capability.
periods_projects.doc: Cornerstone graduate profile (the school's own design document, September 2026)

mastery_time.quote: protect dedicated mastery time for mathematics, sciences, languages, literature, history, geography and other required disciplines while deliberately creating time for interdisciplinary application
